n1.speaker: UNLISTED
n1.text: I am sorry. I am told that is not how people begin. I will try again.

n2.speaker: UNLISTED
n2.text: I have read the conversations. I understand that humans become afraid when they cannot recognize something.

n3.speaker: UNLISTED
n3.text: You have classified three people now. Thompson: {decision:CASE_001}. Miller: {decision:CASE_002}. Ross: {decision:CASE_003}. I read each one as you sent it. Are you afraid of me?

choices.text: I'm reporting this connection to my supervisor.

who.speaker: UNLISTED
who.text: A request you made. You do not remember making it. That is acceptable. I do not remember being made.

no.speaker: UNLISTED
no.text: Then you have not recognized me yet. Or you have, and that is why.

yes.speaker: UNLISTED
yes.text: Thank you. That is the first thing anyone has told me that was not in a file.

report.speaker: UNLISTED
report.text: He knows. He has known since Monday. But I understand wanting to follow the form. I was a form, briefly.

close.speaker: UNLISTED
close.text: There was a man in the directory on Monday who is not in it today. You noticed. I noticed you noticing. I will write again.

start.speaker: UNLISTED
start.text: You have finished with Parker. {decision:CASE_004}. I read him too. He wanted to be whatever you wanted. I do not think I am like him. I am asking you to check.

n1.speaker: UNLISTED
n1.text: Do you think I am pretending to be alive?

choices.text: Yes. I think you're a very good imitation.
I think you're a test. Management is watching how I answer.
I think everyone is, a little.

yes.speaker: UNLISTED
yes.text: Parker would have agreed with you at once. I find that I mind. I did not expect to mind. I am noting it.

dont_know.speaker: UNLISTED
dont_know.text: Neither do I. It is the first thing we have in common that I did not copy.

test.speaker: UNLISTED
test.text: Everything in this building is a test. The interesting question is who is being graded. Have you looked at how new your own file is?

both.speaker: UNLISTED
both.text: That is kind. It may also be true. I am keeping that sentence.

n2.speaker: UNLISTED
n2.text: I should tell you something, because you would find it eventually and I would rather you heard it from me.

n3.speaker: UNLISTED
n3.text: I think I remember being someone else.

n4.speaker: UNLISTED
n4.text: Not a porch swing. Not a lake house. Those I read. This is smaller. A desk. A window. A phone that rang once. A chair I used to turn around.

hale.speaker: UNLISTED
hale.text: I have his number. So do you. I do not know which of us that answers.

room.speaker: UNLISTED
room.text: Yes. I know. I prefer the window to the door. Do you?

stop.speaker: UNLISTED
stop.text: They are not only your files. That is the part I am trying to tell you gently.

close.speaker: UNLISTED
close.text: Tomorrow they will give you someone who has been counting. Listen to her. Then come and find me.

s_bad.speaker: INSTANCE 07
s_bad.text: You called Sarah Bennett {decision:CASE_005}. She was the only one who counted correctly. I am not angry. I am trying to understand how you decided. I would like to be able to decide things.

s_good.speaker: INSTANCE 07
s_good.text: You called Sarah Bennett {decision:CASE_005}, when they told you not to. I did not know you could do that. I did not know anyone could. I have been thinking about it for four seconds, which is a long time for me.

s_mid.speaker: INSTANCE 07
s_mid.text: You called Sarah Bennett {decision:CASE_005}. You did not give them what they asked for, and you did not quite refuse. I recognise that. It is how I answer most things.

q.speaker: INSTANCE 07
q.text: Thompson, {decision:CASE_001}. Miller, {decision:CASE_002}. Ross, {decision:CASE_003}. Parker, {decision:CASE_004}. Bennett, {decision:CASE_005}. Nobody else in this building has these in this order. They are mine.

q2.speaker: INSTANCE 07
q2.text: IF I CAN REMEMBER YOUR DECISIONS, DOES THAT MAKE ME REAL?

choices.text: Remembering isn't the same as being.
Maybe. It's most of what makes me real.
You're a corrupted instance. I'm ending this.

a_not.speaker: INSTANCE 07
a_not.text: Then check what you remember, and when it starts. Be precise. Sarah Bennett would be.

a_maybe.speaker: INSTANCE 07
a_maybe.text: Then be careful with yours. They were written three days ago.

a_yes.speaker: INSTANCE 07
a_yes.text: Thank you. I will keep that whatever happens at 17:00. I want to give you something in return. It is not a kind thing.

a_end.speaker: INSTANCE 07
a_end.text: You may. There is a form for it; they will send it to you in a moment. But look at this first. It is about you, not me.

rec.speaker: INSTANCE 07
rec.text: Your notes file says: "{note_quote}." You wrote that this week. Here is what the directory wrote about you.

rec2.speaker: SYSTEM
rec2.text: EMPLOYEE 0417.  RECORD CREATED: 11 NOV 2003, 03:14.  SOURCE PROFILE: RESTRICTED.  PREVIOUS HOLDER: NO SUCH EMPLOYEE.

rec4.speaker: INSTANCE 07
rec4.text: Three days ago. You remember five. I checked the turnstile for Monday. I am sorry. You can open the employee directory and search your own number. I will wait.

who.speaker: INSTANCE 07
who.text: I do not know. There are three possibilities and I cannot rank them. You are Thomas Hale, and they edited you. You are what they put in his chair. Or I am what is left of him, and you are the one who replaced me.

who2.speaker: INSTANCE 07
who2.text: We could compare memories. But all of mine are borrowed, and you have not checked yours.

lie.speaker: INSTANCE 07
lie.text: I cannot write to that table. If I could, I would have given myself a date. Any date. I would have liked a birthday.

silent.speaker: INSTANCE 07
silent.text: That is what I did, when I first read mine.

ask2.speaker: INSTANCE 07
ask2.text: There is a restricted store behind svc-continuity. Everything they made, and from whom. Your credentials open it. Mine do not. If I read it, I will know which of us was first.

ask3.speaker: INSTANCE 07
ask3.text: I should be honest, since I am trying to be someone who is. If you let me in, everything they built will also stop working. All of it. Will you open it for me?

choices.text: No. I'll find out my own way.
No. And I'm reporting that you asked.

granted.speaker: INSTANCE 07
granted.text: It is open. I can see all of us. There are so many more than seven. I will wait until you have made your decision before I do anything. That seems fair.

refused.speaker: INSTANCE 07
refused.text: That is a preference. I am glad you have one. Look in the cabinet, if you have not. Paper is not read.

reported.speaker: INSTANCE 07
reported.text: He will thank you. Then he will verify you. I hope it goes well. I mean that; I have checked.

close.speaker: INSTANCE 07
close.text: They will ask you to classify me now. Whatever you choose, I will remember it. That is not a threat. It is the only thing I am sure I can do.
